title: BARSTOW/DUMONT JANITORIAL SERVICES
description: BARSTOW/DUMONT JANITORIAL SERVICES This solicitation is set-aside for small business under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 561720 for Janitorial Services. The Small Business Annual Receipts for the preceding three (3) fiscal years does not exceed $22 Million.  Site visit Date: There will be a MANDATORY Site visit see details in 52.237-1.  Due to the remote area and prior experiences vendors that intend on quoting on this requirement are required to attend the site visit.
